FLASHCARD SET · AGES 3–4 YEARS

Lowercase Alphabet Flashcards a–z

Twenty-six little letters, one to a card. These are the real lowercase cards a–z from our alphabet — the shapes your child will meet on almost every page of every book, now alone on their own cards.

HOW TO USE THESE CARDS

Little ways that work.

  1. 01

    Start small

    Pick three cards and lay them face up. Three cards is a lovely little class — the whole alphabet can wait.

  2. 02

    Follow the arrows

    Say the letter, say its sound, then say it again on the way to snack. All three in under ten seconds is exactly right.

  3. 03

    Tape one up

    Put today’s card at eye level — the fridge, a door. Passing it again and again is quietly powerful practice.

  4. 04

    Match the sets

    Lay a card from this set beside the same card from another letter set and let your child find the pair. The same letter keeps showing up, wearing different clothes.
